title: Passage 2  My School
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / there be 句型
passage: My name is Lily. I'm in Class 3, Grade 7. My school is big and beautiful. There are about 1,000 students and 60 teachers in it.

There is a library near the playground, and we often read books there at noon. I have eight classes every day. My favourite subject is art because it is interesting. My art teacher, Ms. Green, is kind and funny. After class, we sometimes draw pictures together. I love my school, so I study hard every day.
vocab: library 图书馆 · playground 操场 · favourite 最喜欢的 · subject 科目 · kind 友善的 · funny 有趣的

questions.stem: How many students are there in Lily's school?
questions.why: 原文：There are about 1,000 students and 60 teachers. 60 是老师的人数。

questions.stem: Where is the library?
questions.why: 原文：There is a library near the playground.

questions.stem: Why does Lily like art?
options: Because her mother is an artist.
Because it is the first class.
questions.why: 原文：My favourite subject is art because it is interesting.

questions.stem: What is Ms. Green like?
questions.why: 原文：My art teacher, Ms. Green, is kind and funny.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: Lily is in Grade 8.
questions.why: 原文：I'm in Class 3, Grade 7. 是七年级。

questions.stem: There are about 60 teachers in Lily's school.
questions.why: 原文：1,000 students and 60 teachers。

questions.stem: Lily often reads books in the library at noon.
questions.why: 原文：we often read books there at noon（there 指 library）。

questions.stem: Lily has six classes every day.
questions.why: 原文：I have eight classes every day. 是八节课。

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: My school is big ____ beautiful.
questions.why: 并列两个形容词 big 和 beautiful，用 and。

questions.stem: There are about 1,000 students ____ my school.
questions.why: in my school 在我的学校里。

questions.stem: The library is ____ the playground.
questions.why: near the playground 在操场附近。

questions.stem: We often read books there ____ noon.
questions.why: at noon 在中午。

questions.stem: I like art ____ it is interesting.
questions.why: 说明原因，用 because。

questions.stem: ____ class, we sometimes draw pictures together.
questions.why: After class 下课后（句首大写）。

questions.stem: I love my school, ____ I study hard every day.
questions.why: 前面是原因，后面是结果，用 so（所以）。

sections.title: 四、用动词的适当形式填空

questions.stem: Lily ____ eight classes every day.
questions.why: Lily 是第三人称单数，have → has。

questions.stem: The students ____ books in the library.
questions.why: The students 是复数，用原形 read。

questions.stem: My friend Amy ____ pictures after class.
questions.why: Amy 是第三人称单数，draw → draws。

questions.stem: They all ____ their school.
questions.why: They 是复数，用原形 love。

questions.stem: Lily ____ hard every day.
questions.why: Lily 是第三人称单数；study 以「辅音字母+y」结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 es → studies。
